title: Checkout webhook retry skips missing subscription after workspace creation commits

reviewers: blind AI reviewer, pass 1 (six Claude subagents, one per batch)
aiReview.rationale: The report's sequence holds: for a new workspace the webhook calls workspaceRepo.create then subscriptionRepo.create on the root db with no transaction; if the subscription insert fails, redelivery finds the workspace, skips both creates and returns 200, and nothing else creates the subscription row.
